Dear Konrad Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Product Analyst position in Toronto. I am studying Information Systems in the University of Toronto's Bachelor of Information program, with an expected graduation in June 2027, and currently work as a Business Intelligence Analyst Co-op at Vale. I am drawn to this role because it connects the parts of product work I enjoy most: understanding user needs, translating business questions into requirements and using evidence to guide decisions.

At Vale, I interviewed six Sales Managers and identified more than ten workflow issues to inform Dynamics 365 CRM requirements. I also built three Power BI solutions combining SAP and Excel data for leadership and more than 20 users. These experiences have taught me to clarify what stakeholders need, make complex information easier to use and connect reporting with the decisions it should support. Alongside this work, I automated five daily processes using VBA, SAP scripting and Power Automate, reducing manual processing time by up to 60% across four teams.

My project work has helped me connect analysis with product design. For TStar, I gathered input through 31 survey responses and 11 interviews, then used paper and mid-fidelity usability testing to identify five issues and inform a redesign. In a separate Instacart recommendation prototype, I used Python and SQL to compare five approaches, achieving 24% recall@5 using data from more than 131,000 shoppers. I also have Tableau experience through university coursework.

Konrad's work across analytics, UX and digital and AI products offers the opportunity to build on this combination of experience. I would bring practical requirements-gathering, dashboarding and research skills, along with a willingness to learn more about product instrumentation, experimentation and consulting delivery. Thank you for considering my application.
